title: a stored dialog geometry is written but never read back
author: Claude-JG
description: Reported by the maintainer against 1.12.95: the store button of the settings dialog saves the settings and the position, but reopening the dialog does not restore the position. Measured: RestoreWindowGeometry returns early unless StoreDialogPositions() is true, so the geometry the store button writes is never read - and the button exists precisely so that a user does not have to switch visualizationSettings.dialogs.storeDialogPositions on (revision2026b step RG12.11). With the flag off the window is asked for the default '900x700' although '1122x1751+7+14' is stored. A second, wider half: StoreDialogPositions() asks GetRendererSystemContainer(), which is None whenever no container is attached to a running renderer, so the whole dialogs mechanism - storing AND restoring - is off for a dialog opened without a renderer, for instance by 'python -m exudyn dialogs' or by a script before renderer.Start(). Measured: GetRendererSystemContainer() is None and StoreDialogPositions() is False even when the container's own flag is True. The rule should be: the flag decides whether a dialog STORES itself when it closes; a geometry that IS stored is used whatever the flag says, and the reachability rule of RG6.2.11 still decides whether the position may be used. NOT YET REPRODUCED, and it needs the message: the maintainer also reports that opening the visualization settings with a config.json holding a dialogs entry 'reports an error', and that removing the entry makes it load. Building the same dialog in a withdrawn window with exactly that file raises nothing, so the text of the error is needed. revision2026b step RG12.13.
